scope: Matched continued-training intervention; retain all seeds and failures; no automatic promotion
selection: Evaluate all four policies and the retained timing_fixed parent on development AND fresh validation; compare each braking seed with its matched control and the parent. No selection based on validation and no omitted arms.
interpretation: Seeds independently resample continued training but share the seed77 parent. Intervention bundles stopping reward and transition curriculum; cannot attribute effects to either alone.
promotion: Requires every development and fresh validation condition to pass, followed by separate integrated qualification. Existing gates unchanged.
